helpers.next: async function(num,locale,title){this.locale=locale;const r=await adminMg.call('design_page',{projectDir:'D:/OPC',documentId:adminMg.doc,designSource:'free-draw',requirement:'新建独立画板 '+num+' '+locale+' '+title+'，1440x1000固定视口。OPC管理后台TDesign Vue Next视觉，自由绘制。中日双语对应，日本国内AI开发业务。'});nodeRepl.write({num,locale,root:JSON.stringify(r).match(/placeholderNodeId: ([^）]+)/)?.[1]});}
helpers.refresh: async function(){const base='C:/Users/Administrator/.mgmcp/resources/design/generated/';const dirs=await adFs.readdir(base);const ms=[];for(const dir of dirs){try{const m=JSON.parse(await adFs.readFile(base+dir+'/meta.json','utf8'));if(m.documentId===adminMg.doc){m.localSource=base+dir+'/index.html';ms.push(m);}}catch{}}adminMg.metas=ms.sort((a,b)=>a.createdAt.localeCompare(b.createdAt));return adminMg.metas.map(m=>({name:m.nodeName,node:m.nodeId||m.placeholderNodeId,status:m.status}));}
helpers.waitLast: async function(){const p=adminMg.pages.at(-1);const str=JSON.stringify(p.result);const task=str.match(/page-gen-[a-zA-Z0-9-]+/)?.[0];if(!task)return;for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const m=JSON.parse(await adFs.readFile('C:/Users/Administrator/.mgmcp/resources/design/generated/'+task+'/meta.json','utf8'));if(m.status!=='accepted'){p.meta=m;nodeRepl.write({key:p.key,status:m.status,node:m.nodeId});return m;}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000));}nodeRepl.write({key:p.key,status:'pending'});}
